convertibility_reason: This is a position management utility (close-by-price controller) that monitors and closes existing positions when price criteria are met, not an automated trading EA with entry/exit signal logic. It does not open trades based on indicators.

other_exits: Closes positions when current price reaches user-specified target price levels - manual price-based close triggers, not indicator-based

position_sizing.conditional_logic: No position opening logic - this EA only closes existing positions

custom_logic_notes: YURAZ_CLOSEPRC is a price-level position closer utility. It allows the user to set target close prices for specific symbols/magic numbers and monitors tick-by-tick whether current Bid/Ask has reached those levels, closing positions accordingly. No autonomous entry logic exists. Version 3.1 adds improved UI panel controls and multi-position close management. The binary file encoding prevents full source analysis - details may be incomplete.
python_conversion_notes: This is a non-trading utility EA. Converting to Python would mean building a monitoring script that polls MT5 positions and closes them when price thresholds are hit. Use MetaTrader5.positions_get() and MetaTrader5.symbol_info_tick() in a loop. No indicator or signal conversion needed. The core logic is simply: if current_price >= target_close_price then close_position(). Binary file could not be fully read - re-export as UTF-8 .mq5 for complete analysis.
